what_this_is: The second full execution of the simulation suite, made after the two defects from run 1 were repaired and before the package was restructured so that research records, simulation cases and simulation results form a one-to-one chain.
why_it_is_kept: The restructure changed which research record each case is attached to. Comparing this run against the post-restructure run shows whether that change altered any numerical result. It did not. Keeping both makes that check reproducible instead of asserted.
difference_from_current_results: Linkage and descriptive text only. The 'actual' object and the 'outcome' field are identical for all five cases.

verification.method: For each of SIM-001..SIM-005, load this directory's result and results/SIM-00N.json and compare the 'actual' dict and the 'outcome' string.

note: This directory is a preserved run record, not a second source of results. Where this directory and results/ disagree on any number, results/ governs and the disagreement is a defect to be recorded, not reconciled by hand.
